about_the_game:
Get a first glimpse of Runic Prophecy in this demo.

Explore the opening of the shattered world of Eyjusheim and experience the core gameplay systems of this third-person, souls-like action RPG.

This Demo Includes:

  • The complete first level (of seven planned in the full game)

  • 3 cutscenes and early story elements

  • Combat encounters with early enemy types

  • One mini-boss and the first of 9 major boss battles

  • Access to 5 of 7 weapon types, each with unique combat styles

  • The ability to ride the first predefined dragon

  • A selection of 2 early rune abilities demonstrating the magic system

  • Character selection and initial stat allocation

  • Environmental interaction: doors, levers, gates, and destructible objects

  • Basic environmental puzzles

  • Health, stamina, and mana potions included to support early survival strategies

  • Climbing sections that demonstrate movement and exploration

Not Included in This Demo (Full Game Only)

  • Additional enemy types, bosses, and more advanced AI

  • Full story progression beyond the introduction

  • More extensive character customization options

  • Weapon and armor upgrades, and additional equipment types

  • Dragon customization and access to multiple dragons

  • Expanded rune system with more abilities and effects

  • Semi-open world exploration

  • Vendors and skill trainers

  • Advanced puzzle mechanics and additional destructible elements

This demo provides a vertical slice of the game’s systems, designed to give players a clear preview of the combat, exploration, and atmosphere of Runic Prophecy. The full version will expand significantly on all areas introduced in this demo.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent fantasy violence and combat against undead and supernatural creatures using medieval weapons such as swords, axes, bows, and daggers. Players can also use magical abilities and spells. Blood effects are shown during combat. The game features a dark fantasy atmosphere with some occult symbolism, such as inverted crosses made of bones. No sexual content, drug use, or self-harm is depicted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smooth performance
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.
